listing.descriptionMarkdown:
## About

Photos and videos you take on the glasses copy themselves into your phone gallery, in the same `Download/Hi Rokid/` album Hi Rokid imports into. They travel over the Bluetooth connection the glasses already have, so neither device needs Wi-Fi.

## Syncing

Choose when it runs: **always**, so a capture syncs as soon as you take it; **while charging**, the default, so transfers happen while the glasses rest on the charger; or **manual only**.

Every file is checksum-verified before it reaches your gallery, and an interrupted transfer resumes where it stopped instead of starting over — so a long video finishes across several sessions.

The transfer stays out of the way of everything else on the connection: it pauses for a camera session and yields whenever anything else needs the link.

## Freeing space

Deleting captures from the glasses once they are safely on the phone is available as an opt-in, off by default. Some glasses refuse it, and the screen says so rather than pretending.

releases.notes:
- First release: glasses captures copy themselves into `Download/Hi Rokid/` on the phone, over Bluetooth — no Wi-Fi on either device.
- Three sync modes: always, while charging (default), or manual only.
- Interrupted transfers resume from where they stopped, and every file is checksum-verified before it reaches the gallery.
- Requires Rokid Nexus 1.0.43 or newer.
